contracts.title: Colts vs. Commanders
contracts.description:
In the upcoming NFL game, scheduled for October 4 at 9:30AM ET:

If Colts wins, the market will resolve to "Colts".

If Commanders wins, the market will resolve to "Commanders".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.

If the game is canceled entirely or ends in a tie, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
